done_when: The review prompt (src/forge/templates/review.md) says: a Not done finding is P1 only when this branch can meet it; work that needs another task's code not yet on the default branch is a P2 naming that task; an edge case the done-when doesn't ask for, where the item's purpose is already met, is a P2; missing tests and functional-check rules are unchanged; a test pins the new wording
why: Reviews block merges with P1 findings that the item can't or needn't meet: a test the plan puts in a task whose code doesn't exist yet, or an edge case beyond what the done-when asks, so tasks take two to four extra rounds
